name: August Pfluger
stance: Leads AI-security research legislation — DHS-run competitions funding interpretability and adversarial robustness — framed as staying ahead of adversaries manipulating AI systems.

statements.text: Sent a letter asking GAO to assess the use of generative AI to radicalize terrorists and develop a strategy to combat it.

AI is supposed to be designed with guardrails to prevent guidance on how to commit acts of violence or terrorism, but the demonstration showed that those safeguards can easily be bypassed. We must fix it.
Introduced the Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act, funding DHS research competitions on AI interpretability and adversarial robustness; the House companion to a Banks-Hassan Senate bill.
The Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act puts American ingenuity to work on making AI more transparent, more predictable, and more resistant to attacks
Adversaries are already looking for ways to manipulate these systems, and we must stay ahead of them
